assertions.assertion: The denial was issued under reason code PR-204.
CPT 93229 corresponds to mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring.
The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness.
The symptoms raise concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia.
Diagnosis code I47.1 is on the claim.
Diagnosis code R42 is on the claim.
The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks.
The transient cerebral ischemic attacks are coded as G45.9.
The note states prolonged ambulatory monitoring is indicated to correlate cardiac rhythm disturbances with the neurological symptoms and dizziness.
The denial determination was that the service is not covered.
An appeal/reconsideration request is being made for this episode.
